candidates.change_summary: Replaced the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender, changing withdrawal semantics and bypassing withdraw(uint).
Removed the require check so onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and affect observed balance.
Replaced transfer with call, forwarding gas and handling success; this can change whether the withdraw reverts and thus observable balance after withdraw.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call withdraw, changing who can trigger balance changes observed after withdraw.
Changed onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT the owner, inverting access control so withdraw behavior under typical owner calls differs.

Change the low-level call to use transfer instead of call, which will revert on failure and may alter whether target receives funds or whether state (depositsCount) or caller sees change due to reversion.
Remove the revert-on-failure branch by performing the call but ignore the returned success value, allowing failures to be silently ignored (so state after call may differ).
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), changing who can invoke sendMoney and thus observable state changes.
